group: hyperbolic conservation laws (1D Euler, 1D shallow water)
access_summary: arxiv.org, HAL, publishers, readthedocs and university hosts were DNS-blocked. Full text was read only from GitHub clones (sodshock, clawpack/riemann, clawpack/riemann_book, Zingale numerical_exercises, SWIFT tests) and a PyPI sdist (tilupy). Toro 2009, Toro-Spruce-Speares 1994, Sod 1978, HLL 1983, Einfeldt 1988, Ritter 1892, Stoker 1957 were not read; their content is cited through those open secondary copies. SWASHES (arXiv:1110.0288) itself was not reachable.

methods.name: Lax-Friedrichs (first order, global wave speed)

equations.label: Conservation law
equations.tex: U_t + F(U)_x = 0,\quad U=(\rho,\rho u,E)^T,\; F=(\rho u,\rho u^2+p,u(E+p))^T,\; p=(\gamma-1)(E-\tfrac12\rho u^2)
equations.location: Euler/Euler-methods.tex, flux vector in Sec. 'Riemann solvers' (verified)

equations.label: LF as two-wave approximate Riemann solver
equations.location: Approximate_solvers.ipynb, cell 13 'Lax-Friedrichs (LF) and local-Lax-Friedrichs (LLF)' (verified)

equations.label: LF numerical flux (global LF: a = dx/dt)
equations.location: derived by us from the riemannbook2020 two-wave form (flux = f(q_l) + s_1 (q_m - q_l)); a = dx/dt identification is our derivation, not seen in a source

equations.label: Classic LF update
equations.location: standard form; original not read (verified: false); equivalent to the flux above with a = dx/dt

equations.label: Local LF / Rusanov speed
equations.location: Approximate_solvers.ipynb cell 13 (scalar form a = max|f'(q)| between q_l and q_r; system form with |u|+c is our specialisation)

assumptions: Smooth or weak solutions; scheme is monotone, first order, very diffusive
methods.discretization: Cell averages on uniform grid; staggered-in-effect centred scheme; global LF has odd-even decoupling in constant states (cells i and i+1 do not communicate directly).
methods.boundary_conditions: Transmissive (zero-gradient ghost cells) at x=0 and x=1 for sod; waves do not reach the boundaries by t=0.2.
methods.stability: CFL: dt * max_i(|u_i|+c_i) / dx <= 1 (domain of dependence; riemannbook2020 Approximate_solvers.ipynb cell 5 states the CFL requirement for Godunov-type methods; LF stability |a dt/dx|<=1 is standard, original not read). Researcher calibration ran at CFL 0.9.

reference_experiments.protocol: N = 100, 200, 400; CFL 0.9; t = 0.2; L1(rho) vs exact; mass/energy conserved to round-off, momentum = 0.9 t

missing: Lax 1954 original not read; classic update quoted from standard form
No published L1 error table for LF on Sod; band from researcher calibration (2.85e-2, 2.02e-2, 1.36e-2 at N=100/200/400)

methods.discretization: Cell-centred finite volume, piecewise constant states, HLLC flux at each face, forward Euler in time.
methods.boundary_conditions: Transmissive (copy of boundary cell into ghost cell).
methods.stability: dt <= C dx / max_i(|u_i|+c_i), C <= 1 (zingale-cha 'Conservative update': dt < dx/(|u|+c); riemannbook2020 cell 5 CFL). Researcher calibration stable at C = 0.9.

reference_experiments.protocol: N = 100, 200, 400; CFL 0.9; t = 0.2; L1(rho) bands 0.021/0.013/0.0085 (first order); plateau values within ~2% at N = 400; observed L1 order ~0.65
u_L = 0.75, x0 = 0.3, t = 0.2: sonic rarefaction; no entropy glitch expected with HLLC

missing: Toro-Spruce-Speares 1994 and Toro 2009 not read; equation numbers unverified
Toro Table 4.3 values only via task brief + snippet (p*, u* to 4 decimals) + sodshock (all four to 17 digits)
No published L1 table for Godunov-HLLC on Sod

equations.location: search snippet (verified: false); Toro 2009 Sec. 14.4 (not read)

equations.location: search snippet describes 'evolved by half a time step using the flux difference across the cell' (verified: false); explicit formula from recollection of Toro 2009 Sec. 14.4

equations.label: Interface Riemann problem
equations.tex: F_{i+1/2}=F^{hllc}\big(\bar U_i^R,\,\bar U_{i+1}^L\big),\quad U_i^{n+1}=U_i^n+\frac{\Delta t}{\Delta x}(F_{i-1/2}-F_{i+1/2})
equations.location: Sec. 14.4 (not read); reduces to Godunov when Delta_i = 0 (ader2023 snippet)

assumptions: Slopes may be limited in conservative, primitive or characteristic variables (choice affects oscillations at the contact; calibration used conservative variables)
TVD limiter keeps scheme non-oscillatory; second order only in smooth regions
methods.discretization: Piecewise-linear reconstruction, half-step predictor with physical flux, Riemann solve (HLLC) at faces, conservative corrector.
methods.boundary_conditions: Transmissive with two ghost cells per side.
methods.stability: CFL C <= 1 for MUSCL-Hancock (Toro 2009, recollection, unverified); researcher calibration stable at C = 0.9.

reference_experiments.protocol: N = 100, 200, 400; CFL 0.9; minmod; L1(rho) bands 0.0095/0.0052/0.0029; error must be below first-order HLLC at each N; observed order ~0.85
with HLL flux for SWE: relative L1(h) 0.0052 (N=200), 0.0026 (N=400)

assumptions: h >= 0; positivity of HLLE for first order (riemannbook2020 cell 52)
methods.discretization: Cell-centred FV, HLL(E) flux, forward Euler; second order via MUSCL-Hancock with positivity fallback to first order where reconstructed h < 0.

researcher_calibration.note: Orders below 1 are expected for solutions with contacts (first-order contact smearing ~ N^-1/2) and shocks; textbook statements (first order ~N^-1/2 at contacts, ~N^-2/3 for second order) are recollection, not sourced.
